bean soup for a week: get a bag of those dried assorted beans from anywhere (don't use canned) > throw the seasoning packet in the garbage right where it belongs > beans in pot with lots of water > put in fridge overnight (longer is a-ok) > drain beans and add fresh water, ham chunks, a bit of red pepper, some sea salt and a few tablespoons of good olive oil - not that shit that says "good olive oil" on the bottle, but the shit that is 1st cold-pressed organic non-GMO olive oil from Spain (preferably) > put on stove and bring to near boil, then turn down to simmer until beans are almost tender > add potatoes, carrots, 1 whole onion, whatever else you want - i like to add 1/2 a box of wild rice mix without the seasoning + just a tablespoon or so of soy sauce > let simmer until veggies are done -- you can add a little bacon too at the same time you add the ham, but you have to fry it up extra-crisp beforehand (read: burnt)

spaghetti for one: (no, really, we're talking some pretty fuckin' good spaghetti here, trust me) couple cups of water in a pot > boil > meanwhile, crush, peel and chop up a pile of fresh garlic (no, garlic powder is NOT an option) - i use at least 6 nice size cloves > combine garlic, a little red pepper, even if you don't like it, or a little more if you do, 1/2 a jar of Paul Newman's marinara sauce (NO, not fucking Preggo!), a couple tablespoons of good olive oil (i already warned you about that :) ) and some chopped green Spanish olives and pimentos (the red things) with just a little olive juice (no salt needed if use a little juice) > heat until hot, but not boiling > water is boiling by now, so add pasta - about a 1.5 in. bunch (diameter) is plenty - break it in half so it fits in pot > when pasta is done, you know what to do :) for a better sauce, add some pre-cooked pork sausage (no hamburger!)

grilled cheese for one: you need good bread, like an Italian loaf, not that gummy Stroehmann shit > slice 2 one-half inch slices > on one slice, put some nice, white, sharp cheddar cheese (not that crappy American shit that is pure fat labeled as "cheese") > on top of cheese add a single layer of sliced hot banana peppers > on top of banana peppers, add some Paul Newman's marinara sauce > on top of that, add a slice or two of ham > prepare frying pan with a little butter (not the margarine crap, but real butter! because it's actually good for you) and put on med. heat > dump your loaded up bread in there and put the other slice on top, sprinkle a little sea salt on it and cover the pan > the shit burns FAST, so you have to keep an eye on it, but when the bread is nice and dark brown on the bottom, flip the whole mess over, add a little more sea salt and brown the other side -- if it's still not quite done enough (cheese isn't melted), you can nuke it for a min., but the better way is to add a tiny amount of water during the frying process and steam it until the water is gone because we know that nuking food is not healthy
